topic: A person's invention is already patented by someone else
text: I shouldn't have ignored the patent search results. When I first saw my idea listed under someone else's name, I told myself it was coincidence, that my invention was unique enough to stand apart. Now, as I face the reality of their patent, I can't help but think of the time and resources I've poured into this. I should have acted more diligently, more thoroughly. The weight of this oversight presses down, making every step towards the next decision feel heavier. I must now navigate this challenge with what little grace I can muster, hoping to find a path that respects both their rights and the spirit of my work.
